profile.headline: Senior software engineer for IBM Cloud Private at IBM
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack web application developer currently architecting and delivering microservices within
Kubernetes platforms. I am a leader who creates best practice documents for my team
and others, as well as guiding our team to success in new projects. I am in control
of creating architectural designs for new features. Using technology, such as Github
Enterprise, Jenkins, Travis, Slack, Zenhub, and Box, I keep my co-workers informed of new technology and CI practices. I have deep knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Javascript,
React, HTML, CSS, and other technologies to create new features and help get
products out of the door quickly. I also utilize bash scripting and have a basic knowledge of Terraform to automate infrastructure deployments.
I work with UX designers to ensure features are well handled and I make sure the user
experience of our customers is satisfactory by discussing serviceability items with the
development team often. I also collaborate across teams to ensure all data is available
that should be supplied to our team to fulfill the requirements for our projects.
With all the changes being made daily, I have no problem adapting to new code be
it server side or client side. Currently, I work with IBM Cloud Private and Multicloud
Manager. I also take time to automate things that are often repetitive with whatever
tools that make it easy instead of using the tools that are recommended because of
consistency's sake. If something can be done simple, I want to make a case for that
before adding unnecessary complexity.

positions.title: Senior software engineer for the management console on IBM Cloud Private
positions.description:
I'm leading a wonderful team that is responsible for creating the UI experience for our application on top of a Kubernetes cluster. Each day, I am responsible for creating feature specifications, collaborating with other teams, gathering requirements, and implementing new features with React and NodeJS. 

I often help others with my vast knowledge of CICD to setup with Github repositories and configuring them with Travis for automation. I continuously seek out new tools that will help our team collaborate and work more efficiently. I am also responsible for creating shared UI component libraries for use among our UI teams. I also lead my team members to innovate and publish new patent ideas. We meet bi-weekly to discuss new things and hopefully lead to a newly published patent. I help teams daily with the use of our product via setting up cloud environments and deploying using automation tools.

I often find myself coming up with ways to automate a process that is often repetitive and manual. Mentoring others is a passion of mine that I make sure to do each and every day.

positions.title: Lead for Helm API squad for IBM Cloud Private
positions.description:
I took on the lead role for the Helm API squad. With my wonderful team, we engineered a REST API that communicates with tiller which is used to install helm charts into a running Kubernetes cluster. 
With my small squad, we were able to innovatively create a NodeJS based application that communicated with tiller using GRPC and surfaced the communication to other applications via our REST API. 
We also made opensource updates to the helm package to add security.
I learned a lot about creating and using SSL certificates for TLS communication between services within the Kubernetes cluster. 
I have also obtained a vast understanding of Kubernetes and how to manage and deploy resources into the platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer - UI for Hybrid cloud
positions.description:
Experience writing product code from scratch
Works with React to add new widgets to UI
Responsible for implementing REST Interface with Node JS and Java
Works with Bluemix Cloud platform
Implemented automated functional and end to end tests using Grunt, Mocha and Chai assertion libraries
Knowledge of creating Docker images and loading applications onto Docker containers stored in Bluemix.
Automated continuous integration process
Created security features for UI using passport and Oauth2 module
Lead team to migrate from Rational repositories to using new standard code repositories like GIT
Added map widget using D3 as a React widget
Jenkins DSL pipeline master
Setup framework for UI unit tests using mocha, jsdom, React TestUtils
Understanding of creating Docker containers and adding as part of the continuous delivery pipeline
Transitioning CD process to use Kubernetes clusters instead of normal containers
Created framework for end to end tests using mocha, webdriverio, and selenium server
Reaches across team boundaries to help integrate successfully with other products
Knowledge of IBM Design thinking
Works hard to stay ahead and understand new technology that may help our team function better

positions.title: Web site developer
positions.description:
I design and develop web sites with guidance from the customer.
The technologies I use are Dreamweaver, Flash CS6, Photoshop CS6, Javascript, CSS, HTML5, JQuery, and other scaffolding technologies like NodeJS, WebdriverJS, etc.
I also develop customized widgets to go on the sites incase something doesn't already exist
that the customer needs.

Some examples include the following:
http://vchapelnc.com - 2012
http://www.ahplumbingnc.com/ - 2012
http://www.getspirituallyfit.com/ (still under construction) - 2011
http://www.premierdentistryofwakeforest.com -2012 -- only made updates to this page
http://www.premiersmilesnc.com July 2013

References available if needed.

positions.title: Web site developer
positions.description: Given a general diagram, I created a web site using PHP, HTML, and MySQL that has search capabilities during my 3 month co-op position.
